info.name: EnergyMeneger main — all controllers
info.description:
Source: https://github.com/ArtyomV11/EnergyMeneger/commit/26736fc7c5818ec494c610f3d52c6b3e5efad20c
7 controllers; all 22 method/route combinations. Import environment; fill ownerLogin and ownerPassword from Bootstrap configuration. Run folders in order. Default: read-only plus negative authorization tests. Set runWriteTests=true for full isolated write scenario. It permanently adds a 60 kW workshop, raises substation limit by 60 kW and creates two employees; cleanup disables equipment and blocks employees. History prevents removal; original Bootstrap objects are not edited. Use a disposable database for a fully clean reset. Each full run uses new unique names. Login limiter: 10/minute/IP; one run uses fewer than 10 logins. Wait one minute before repeating. No refresh/register/delete-user endpoints exist.
